A guide to the seperation of MCU code:

**Firmare/adcs_stm32** is the code generated by CubeMX "Generate Code". this is all the startup, linker, HAL, interupt, etc

**platform/stm32/adcs** is all the missing code that we write in order to talk to the HAL.

**apps/adcs** is the actual portable mission logic, tasks, control, estimation, telem, etc. Everything else i suppose.
